scenario.goal_zh: 确认只使用教师准备的材料，并商定记录肥皂泡持续时间的方法

context_zh: 学生在教师准备好的课堂材料旁，弄清实验要求仅是观察而非添加物质。
author: author-phase05-a

sentences.speaker: Ruth
sentences.text: Is this clear liquid just water?

sentences.speaker: Science teacher
sentences.text: It is water with a little soap in it. Do not add any other chemical to the tray.

sentences.speaker: Ruth
sentences.text: What are we supposed to measure?

sentences.speaker: Science teacher
sentences.text: The basic task is to time how long one bubble lasts before it bursts.

sentences.speaker: Ruth
sentences.text: So I start the timer as soon as the bubble forms?

sentences.speaker: Science teacher
sentences.text: Yes. Your partner can watch the bubble while you watch the timer.

sentences.speaker: Ruth
sentences.text: All right. We will record three attempts separately rather than guess an average.

sentences.speaker: Science teacher
sentences.text: Good. Use the tray I have prepared, and call me if you need more liquid.
